# Account reference

Every method of the account resources and every object they return. Types link to their section; objects used by several areas are in [shared objects](shared.md).

## Structure

The objects each method returns, and the objects inside them. An object is expanded the first time it appears.

- `details()`: [`Account`](#account)
  - `balance()`: [`Balance`](#balance)
    - `buckets()`: `list<`[`CreditBucket`](#creditbucket)`>`
  - `spendCap()`: [`SpendCap`](#spendcap)
  - `limits()`: [`AccountLimits`](#accountlimits)
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
    - `credits()`: `?`[`Credits`](shared.md#credits)
- `usage()`: [`Results`](shared.md#results)`<`[`Usage`](#usage)`>`
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
- `requests()`: [`Results`](shared.md#results)`<`[`RequestLogEntry`](#requestlogentry)`>`
- `requests()`: `iterable<int, `[`RequestLogEntry`](#requestlogentry)`>`

| `withMaxCacheAge(int $seconds)` | `static` | Returns a copy that keeps answers at most this many seconds in the cache. |
| `withoutCache()` | `static` | Returns a copy that neither reads nor writes the cache. |
